title: Notice regarding virtual conduct of court proceedings by the Hon'ble Court.
text:
KEY LINES:
09.06.2025 to 07.07.2025. The learned Advocates and/or

FULL TEXT:
The High Court of Gujarat
Ahmedabad.
N O T I C E
HCG-01/2025
It is hereby informed to the all Learned
Advocate(s)/Party-in-Person(s)/Litigants that Special Bench
of Hon’ble Mr. Justice Umesh A.Trivedi has been
constituted and it would conduct the Court Proceedings
virtually from the official residence of His Lordship w.e.f.
09.06.2025 to 07.07.2025. The learned Advocates and/or
parties who are desirous to appear virtually can appear
through Video Conferencing facility available either from
Court Room No. 13 or through Video Conferencing from any
other location.
By Order of The Hon’ble The Chief Justice
Sd/-
I/c.Registrar (Judicial)
